name: How long does a typical room expansion take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical room expansion take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a room expansion project depends on its size and complexity. A small, straightforward addition might take 2-4 months from design to completion. Larger or more complex projects, especially those requiring extensive architectural changes or dealing with unexpected site conditions, can take 6 months or more. Permitting timelines in areas like Berkeley or Oakland can also influence the overall schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical room expansion can take anywhere from 2 to 6 months or more, depending on its size and complexity.
